entities.name: Service
entities.description: An engineering service offered (e.g., APS, SOUE, SOT, OS, SKUD, SKS, EOM, EO). Each service has its own dedicated landing page.

entities.name: ProjectCase
entities.description: A portfolio case study of a completed project.

entities.name: ServicePackage
entities.description: A predefined tier of service (e.g., Basic, Standard, Premium).

flows.name: Cost Estimation & Lead Capture
steps: User opens a Service landing page.
User inputs object type, area, and complexity into the Mini-Calculator.
System calculates an estimated price range.
System sends the Lead data to CRM, Email, and Telegram bot.

flows.name: Information Discovery
steps: User explores problems solved by the service.
User reviews included equipment and work stages.
User compares service packages and pricing tables.
User views past ProjectCases and company licenses.
